mutation: broker-owned ephemeral counter; current exact writer and route epoch, forwarded request, current caller and service policy/session checks on every commit
ordering: fence clears writer and increments epoch; fresh grant; route publication; requests fail unavailable between steps
retry: exact duplicate returns retained immutable result; pending duplicate WouldBlock; changed duplicate denied; lower/equal id after result expiry StaleEpoch; restart loses results and authority
death: explicit rejection when authority survives; unknown outcome after authority loss; trusted bootstrap starts fresh resource and policy incarnation; no automatic replay
limitations: no universal direct-handle or mapping revocation
